D/ HADRIANVS AVG COS III PP

A silver Roman denarius of Hadrian (117-138 AD), struck towards the end of his reign, between 134 and 138 AD. The coin was minted in Rome. The obverse legend reads HADRIANVS AVG COS III PP and the reverse reads ITALIA and depicts Italia standing left holding sceptre and a cornucopiae. The coin is RIC number 307(a) and is of Reece period 6
